Ideathon project · Team leader

NIRBHAYA

A women's safety app. I led our team through many ideathon contests, and this was the main project: we designed a solution and built the prototype of an app with these seven ideas.

🎤

AI Voice SOS

Detects distress words and panic-related voice patterns for hands-free emergency alerts.

🚗

Safe Journey Mode

Monitors route deviations, unusual stops and movement patterns.

💡

Dynamic Safe Routes

Recommends routes based on safety factors such as lighting, crowd density and nearby safety facilities.

🔔

Safety Confirmation Alerts

Checks whether the user is safe before escalating a potential emergency.

🚨

Multi-Level Emergency Escalation

Proposes notifying trusted contacts, nearby verified safe locations and the police.

📱

Offline Emergency Mode

Proposes sending emergency SMS messages with GPS coordinates when there is no internet.

🔒

Evidence Vault

Envisions securely storing incident audio and journey information, with automatic recording when the AI detects danger.
